key_insight: CrystalAR unifies crystal symmetry templates and full 3D structures in one autoregressive sequence, preserving symmetry while exploring new crystal configurations.
engineering_relevance: The framework could support computational materials discovery by generating crystals and predicting structures without retrieving symmetry templates from prior data.
method: Jointly generate Wyckoff symmetry templates and complete crystal structures.
Localize symmetry-inequivalent sites through hierarchical, symmetry-conditioned discrete spatial decisions.
Use constraint-aware search over both crystallographic templates and geometric realizations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong symmetry-template generation and competitive de novo generation and template-free crystal structure prediction, but provides no datasets or quantitative metrics.
watch_item: The computational cost and geometric precision of hierarchical spatial refinement and constraint-aware search require assessment.
paper_title: CrystalAR: Autoregressive Modeling for Symmetric Crystal Generation
